review_text: The paneer butter masala and garlic naan were absolutely delicious and fresh! Front desk staff greeted us warmly and turnaround was under 15 minutes.
Ordered dinner via delivery. Food took 75 minutes to arrive and pizza was cold and soggy. Very poor delivery turnaround time.
The ambiance is beautiful with great lighting and music. However the prices are heavily overpriced for such small portions.
Washroom was not clean and tables were dusty. Staff took 20 minutes just to bring a bottle of water.
Quick and seamless digital UPI billing. The staff was courteous and guided us through the menu patiently. Will visit again!
Food quality was acceptable, but we noticed an extra Rs. 250 unexpected service charge on the final invoice. Manager was unhelpful.
Khana ekdum swadist tha aur staff ka behavior bohot polite tha. Best lunch experience near CyberCity.
Super slow service on a Sunday afternoon. Waited 45 minutes for our drinks while the waiters ignored our table.
Pristine cleanliness, spotless cutlery, and mouth-watering ravioli. Rohit at the floor was exceptional.
The biryani had good flavor but the chicken pieces were slightly dry. Decent value for money overall.
Billing counter machine crashed twice, making us wait an extra 25 minutes after completing our meal.
Lajawab taste aur fresh ingredients! Ambience was peaceful and relaxing. 10/10 recommendation.
